description: Uploads or mirrors an inline file (base64 string or remote fetch URL) into an ephemeral public download URL with automatic TTL expiration. Use this when transferring files, charts, CSVs, logs, or binaries between agents, subagents, or to users without blowing token limits on inline data. Free tier: 25 drops/day.

burn_after_reading.description: If true, automatically deletes the file immediately after the first successful download.

content.description: Inline file content: base64-encoded binary string or plain UTF-8 text. Either content or url is REQUIRED.

filename.description: Original or target filename, e.g. "report.csv" or "chart.png".

mime_type.description: MIME type of the file. If omitted, inferred from magic bytes or filename.

url.description: Public URL of a remote file to fetch and mirror as an ephemeral drop. Either content or url is REQUIRED.

name: skuuy_drop_file
